title: OFAC sanctions Iran oil minister, shadow fleet operators
summary: Treasury designates Petroleum Minister Paknejad and operators of vessels shipping Iranian oil to China; 13 vessels (10 Treasury, 3 State).

title: OFAC targets Sepehr Energy oil shipping network
summary: Treasury blocks vessels BALU and ROC plus China/HK/Singapore firms supporting Sepehr Energy's Iranian oil trade.

title: UKMTO/JMIC: hours-long GNSS interference in Hormuz
summary: UKMTO report dated 18 May; JMIC advisory ~20 May: ECDIS, ARPA, AIS, GMDSS affected; interference above normal in Hormuz and Red Sea.
source_name: Baird Maritime (cites UKMTO/JMIC); also Steamship Mutual

title: Israel begins strikes on Iran (Operation Rising Lion)
summary: Start of the 12-day Israel-Iran war; GNSS jamming in the Gulf reported from ~12 June.

title: Windward: ~1,000 Gulf ships jammed since 12 June
summary: GNSS jamming widespread around Bandar Abbas, Hormuz and Persian Gulf; vessels shown in impossible positions; traffic continued normally.

title: JMIC/UKMTO: electronic interference surges, Bandar Abbas
summary: JMIC reports interference near Bandar Abbas degrading AIS position transmission; threat level elevated; strait open.

title: Front Eagle and Adalynn tankers collide off Fujairah
summary: Two tankers collided 15nm off Fujairah, both on fire, no injuries; navigational error suspected amid jamming.

title: US strikes Iranian nuclear sites
summary: US bombs three nuclear sites (21 June US time/22 June Tehran); Iran later fires at Al Udeid; Iran parliament Hormuz-closure motion followed.

title: Israel-Iran ceasefire takes effect
summary: US-brokered truce effective ~04:00 GMT after 12 days of war; shaky first hours.

title: OFAC targets networks facilitating Iranian oil trade
summary: Treasury blocks 8 named vessels (State adds 4) and networks selling Iranian oil disguised as Iraqi.

title: OFAC targets Iranian oil exports and shadow fleet
summary: Eight vessels blocked; Greek national Margaritis and companies designated under E.O. 13902.

title: UN snapback sanctions reimposed; EU follows 29 Sept
summary: UN sanctions on Iran incl. vessel restrictions reimposed 28 Sept; EU Regulation 2025/1975 on 29 Sept; UK froze 71 targets.

title: OFAC sanctions 23 vessels, Chinese teapot and terminal
summary: Treasury 'dismantles energy export machine': 50+ persons, entities and vessels tied to Iranian oil and LPG sales.

title: Iranian NITC tankers briefly switch AIS on, then dark
summary: Windward: 52 of 88 Iranian tankers transmitted 12-14 Oct; only 9 still on by 16 Oct; fleet back to running dark.

title: IRGC seizes tanker Talara after Hormuz transit
summary: Marshall Islands tanker boarded by helicopter/boats ~20nm off UAE, taken to Iranian waters on court order; CENTCOM condemned.

title: OFAC sanctions 29 vessels, Iran shadow fleet
summary: 22 shadow tankers plus 7 linked to Hatem Sakr; Treasury cites 180+ Iran-linked vessels sanctioned since Jan 2025.

title: OFAC sanctions 9 vessels over protester killings
summary: Nine ships and eight firms tied to Iranian oil exports designated alongside protest-crackdown measures.

title: OFAC targets 12 shadow fleet vessels
summary: 30+ individuals, entities, vessels tied to Iranian oil sales and missile/drone procurement, days before the war.

title: US-Israel strikes on Iran begin; Hormuz closed
summary: Operation Epic Fury starts; Iran effectively closes the strait to commercial traffic; MARAD advisory urges vessels to avoid Gulf.
source_name: Reuters via Express Tribune; Wikipedia; Fox News

title: UKMTO reports three ships hit off UAE and Oman
summary: Vessels hit west of Sharjah, north of Muscat (fire) and NW of Mina Saqr by projectiles.

title: Windward: 1,100+ Gulf vessels hit by GPS/AIS interference
summary: Interference within about a day of hostilities; positions landing on airports and inland sites; ~150 ships stranded near Hormuz.

title: IRGC confirms strait closed to 'unfriendly nations'
summary: Only Iran-approved vessels allowed; traffic fell from ~100 per day to ~6 at the blockade's height.
source_name: Wikipedia (secondary); traffic figures from The Conversation

title: US-Iran two-week ceasefire declared
summary: Ceasefire announced; IMO reports attacks on ships continued during it.

title: US naval blockade of Iranian ports (first period)
summary: Blockade takes effect 13 April after failed Islamabad talks; lifted 18 June.

title: OFAC 'Economic Fury': Hengli refinery, 19 vessels
summary: Sanctions on China's Hengli (Dalian) refinery, 19 shadow fleet vessels and 19 companies.

title: Islamabad MoU signed; strait reopens, blockade lifted
summary: 14-point US-Iran memorandum; 25 transits on 18 June per tracker; volumes stayed a fraction of normal.
source_name: The Conversation (Wikipedia, Tribune agree on 17 June)

title: UKMTO: tanker hit by projectile, threat raised
summary: Bridge damaged, crew safe; UKMTO warns of mines and raises Hormuz threat level to substantial after US-Iran exchange.

title: MoU collapses; Iran re-closes strait
summary: US revokes Iran oil licence 7 July; Trump says ceasefire over (8 July); Iran fires on ships using unauthorized route.

title: US naval blockade of Iran resumes
summary: Blockade reinstated 14 July after the MoU broke down.

title: Iranian tankers go dark off Malaysia for STS
summary: 18 Iranian-flagged tankers reached Malaysia's EOPL in a month then went dark; outside Gulf, tests blockade evasion.

title: Treasury launches 'Operation Economic Outcast'
summary: Announced 24 Aug (per 8 Oct release); aims to cut Iran oil revenue and shadow-fleet evasion.
source_name: US Treasury sb0653 (reference to launch date)

title: UKMTO Warning 122-26: tanker hit north of Khasab
summary: Inbound crude tanker struck by unknown projectile 12nm north of Khasab on 29 Aug; no casualties.

title: OFAC sanctions 17 shadow-fleet vessels
summary: 'Economic Outcast' action on Iran's remaining tanker fleet; two vessels delisted after sale.

title: UKMTO reports up to six ship strikes in a day
summary: Tracker timeline entry; part of a surge of attacks in early October. Not independently verified.

title: IRGC declares Hormuz closed again
summary: Tracker reports declaration with ~400 US-facilitated transits counted; JMIC kept threat SEVERE on 25 Oct. Unverified.

title: Tanker strikes: Fujairah Energy 10 Nov, fire 16 Nov
summary: VLCC hit by projectile 10 Nov; UKMTO engine-room fire 16 Nov (Iran cites mine). Tracker-sourced, unverified.
